scripts.text:
[Mister Mobry]
Trees possess spirits you know...
scripts.translation:
[莫布里先生]
樹木擁有精靈，你知道嗎...

scripts.text:
[Mister Mobry]
In fact I know a secret about these spirits that can in some way... perhaps aid you...
scripts.translation:
[莫布里先生]
事實上，我知道關於這些精靈的一個秘密，它或許能在某種程度上...幫助你...

scripts.text:
[Mister Mobry]
I can create a spirited branch... That is, if you can provide me with the correct materials...
scripts.translation:
[莫布里先生]
我可以製作一根擁有精靈的樹枝...前提是你能提供正確的材料...

scripts.text: Where Can I find this Crap?

[Mister Mobry]
Mwehehe... I see you want to control tree spirits am I right? Ok... I need:
^1354453 Logs^000000
^1354451 Wooden Heart^000000
^1354455 Trunk^000000
^1354451 Wooden Gnarl^000000

[Mister Mobry]
You can find the following items from certain monsters heheh...
^135445Logs can be found off of Tree Golems.^000000
^135445Wooden Hearts the essence of Tree Golems.^000000
^135445Trunks? Seriously, think wood...^000000
^135445Wooden Gnarl... Gibbet...^000000
scripts.translation:
[莫布里先生]
這些東西都能從特定的魔物身上找到，嘿嘿...
^135445原木可以從樹木巨人身上獲得。^000000
^135445樹木心臟是樹木巨人的精華。^000000
^135445樹幹？想想那些木頭做的魔物呀...^000000
^135445原木塊...去找鬼娃樹...^000000

scripts.text:
[Mister Mobry]
^135445Logs^000000 are the body... I need more of them.
Get me three logs and I'll make you the spirit...
scripts.translation:
[莫布里先生]
^135445原木^000000是身體...我需要更多。
給我三根原木，我就為你製作精靈...

scripts.text:
[Mister Mobry]
The ^135445Wooden Heart^000000 is the essence of the spirit.
Get me one wooden heart and I'll make you the spirit...
scripts.translation:
[莫布里先生]
^135445樹木心臟^000000是精靈的精髓。
給我一顆樹木心臟，我就為你製作精靈...

scripts.text:
[Mister Mobry]
What? You couldn't even find ^1354455 Trunks^000000?
Kill Elder Willows or something... Geez... no trunks heh... pathetic.
scripts.translation:
[莫布里先生]
什麼？你連^1354455根樹幹^000000都找不到？
去殺長老樹精之類的...天哪...沒有樹幹，呵呵...真可悲。

scripts.text:
[Mister Mobry]
How can I make one without a ^135445Wooden Gnarl^000000?
I said Gibbet... they are all around this place...
scripts.translation:
[莫布里先生]
沒有^135445原木塊^000000我怎麼製作？
我說了是鬼娃樹...這附近到處都是...

scripts.text:
[Mister Mobry]
Well...let us see what you brought me...
scripts.translation:
[莫布里先生]
嗯...讓我看看你帶來了什麼...

scripts.text:
[Mister Mobry]
Heh... Hope you have fun with the tree spirits... Careful now...
Heh... careful now? What do I care if you di..... Never mind.
scripts.translation:
[莫布里先生]
呵...希望你玩得開心...小心點...
呵...小心點？我管你死不死...算了。

scripts.text:
[Mister Mobry]
No spirit for you... then go!
scripts.translation:
[莫布里先生]
沒有精靈給你...滾吧！
